content.short: A free Python-based tool that exports NFT data to CSV.
content.description: NFT Analyst Starter Pack is a Python-based tool that extracts analytical data from NFT collections. With an API key and the collection's contract address, users can retrieve transfers, sales records, and NFT metadata, then compute rarity scores to inform research and valuation. The Starter Pack consolidates essential NFT metrics into actionable insights, making NFT data analysis more accessible for researchers, developers, and enthusiasts.
